tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations span a substantial s_grad range and a broad u_now range, providing variation for the four guided parameters without the stated narrow-gradient identifiability issue. Fit the specified barrier-modulated siphon with the sqrt branch, fixing the provided tau scale and numerically estimating all target parameters.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is broad (2.0), not the narrow-collinearity condition specified for acquiring this probe; existing rows vary u_now and s_grad enough to fit the guided four-parameter law.
No temporal trajectory evidence or long-horizon concern is indicated; the target horizon is 0.7 and the identified candidate is an algebraic readout.

considered_alternatives.option: smooth unbarriered siphon or linear mass-drift branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Pilot signatures and authorized co-activation guidance identify barrier modulation plus the open square-root branch as the candidate mechanism.
It is explicitly irrelevant to the target model and costs more than the discriminating probe.
